title: Six, Seven, Eight
label: ch:ge-zahlen-6-8
canDo: I can count six, seven and eight in German, and hear the three sounds that make them hard to guess from the spelling.

payoff.summary: Three more numbers, each with the sound that makes it unguessable from the page: the chs of sechs, the buzzing s of sieben, and the throat sound in acht that English spells gh.
payoff.note: Chapter 8 is generated from schema-v2 lessons, so the payoff is atom-scored. It introduces 8 atoms, under the maxNewAtomsPerChapter of 12: the numbers one to ten were split across four chapters rather than crammed into one, because German's own band is a median of 9 and 23 of its 29 atom-bearing chapters sit at or under the ceiling. Lesson ids keep the GE-C06-* prefix.
